1.consolidated_definition: Expresión usada para indicar que algo o alguien está listo, a punto. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. El carro no esta terminado completamente le faltan unos ajustes pero casi esta ready to go para mas informacion Adorno’s Precision Center vean mas fotos de el carro (Autos Racing Puerto Rico, 02-02-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Expression used to indicate that something or someone is ready or about to happen. Raw Anglicism, relatively uncommon. The car is not completely finished; it still needs some adjustments but it's almost ready to go for more information Adorno’s Precision Center see more photos of the car (Autos Racing Puerto Rico, 02-02-08)
